title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
desc: 愛麗絲追著白兔掉進兔子洞，遇見瘋狂茶會、會說話的貓，還一下變大一下變小。

intro: Today let's talk about 'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland,' especially the Mad Tea Party!
今天來聊《愛麗絲夢遊仙境》，特別是瘋狂茶會！

q: The Hatter and the March Hare have tea all day because time stopped at six o'clock. Would you enjoy a never-ending tea party?
帽匠和三月兔整天喝茶，因為時間停在六點。你會喜歡永遠不結束的茶會嗎？
o: Only if there are enough snacks!
只要點心夠多就好！
only if = 只有在…的條件下。snacks = 點心。
Ha! In the book, they never wash a cup. They just move to the next clean one.
哈！書裡他們從不洗杯子，只是換到下一個乾淨的。
No way. I'd get bored quickly.
才不要。我很快就會膩。
No way = 才不要。get bored = 感到無聊。
Alice felt the same. She left because they were so rude.
愛麗絲也這麼覺得。她因為他們太無禮而離開了。
Sounds like my weekends!
聽起來像我的週末！
Sounds like = 聽起來像。用自己的生活來開玩笑。
A relaxing weekend with a pot of tea sounds perfect to me.
有一壺茶的放鬆週末聽起來很完美。

q: The March Hare offers Alice wine, but there isn't any! How do you usually take your tea?
三月兔請愛麗絲喝酒，但根本沒有酒！你通常怎麼喝茶？
o: With milk and a little sugar.
加牛奶和一點糖。
take your tea 在這裡是「喝茶的方式」。
The British way! That fits the book perfectly.
英式喝法！跟這本書很搭。
Plain green tea, no sugar.
無糖綠茶。
plain = 原味的、不加東西的。
Very healthy. Green tea has such a fresh taste.
很健康。綠茶有一種清新的味道。
I prefer bubble tea, honestly.
老實說，我比較喜歡珍奶。
prefer = 比較喜歡。
Ha! I'd love to see the Hatter try tapioca pearls.
哈！好想看帽匠吃珍珠。

q: The Dormouse tells a story about three sisters who live at the bottom of a treacle well. Treacle is a sweet syrup. Have you ever tried a strange food?
睡鼠講了三姊妹住在糖漿井底的故事。treacle 是一種甜糖漿。你吃過奇怪的食物嗎？
o: Yes, stinky tofu!
有，臭豆腐！
stinky = 臭的。
I've heard it smells terrible but tastes amazing!
我聽說它聞起來很可怕，但吃起來超讚！
I once tried fried insects.
我曾經吃過炸昆蟲。
fried = 油炸的。insect = 昆蟲。
Wow, you're brave! Even Alice might say no to that.
哇，你好勇敢！連愛麗絲可能都會拒絕。
No, I'm a picky eater.
沒有，我很挑食。
picky eater = 挑食的人。
That's okay! Wonderland food would scare you, then.
沒關係！那仙境的食物應該會嚇到你。

q: Earlier, Alice eats a little cake with 'EAT ME' on it and grows huge. If you found a cake like that, would you eat it?
更早之前，愛麗絲吃了寫著「吃我」的小蛋糕，變得超大。如果你找到那種蛋糕，會吃嗎？
o: Of course! I'm curious.
當然！我很好奇。
curious = 好奇的。
Curiosity is what drives the whole book!
好奇心就是推動整本書的力量！
No, it could be dangerous.
不要，可能會有危險。
could be = 可能是。
Very sensible. Alice doesn't think twice, and trouble follows.
很理智。愛麗絲想都沒想，麻煩就跟著來了。
Only if it's a chocolate dessert.
除非是巧克力甜點。
dessert = 甜點。注意和 desert（沙漠）拼法不同。
Ha! Your priorities are very clear.
哈！你的優先順序很清楚。

end: What a mad party! Next time, let's explore the strange houses of Wonderland.
好瘋狂的派對！下次來探索仙境裡奇怪的房子吧。

intro: Let's talk about the strange places in Wonderland: tiny doors, long halls, and the White Rabbit's house.
我們來聊仙境裡奇怪的地方：小小的門、長長的走廊，還有白兔的房子。

q: Alice falls into a long hall full of locked doors. She finds a tiny key for a tiny door. What would you do in that hall?
愛麗絲掉進一條滿是上鎖門的長廊。她找到一把開小門的小鑰匙。你在那個走廊裡會做什麼？
o: Try every door, one by one.
一扇一扇試每一扇門。
one by one = 一個接一個。
Very logical! Alice does the same thing at first.
很有邏輯！愛麗絲一開始也是這麼做。
Look for a way back up.
找回去上面的路。
a way back = 回去的路。
Smart, but there's no ladder or stairs anywhere.
聰明，但到處都沒有梯子或樓梯。
Sit down and cry, honestly.
老實說，坐下來哭。
honestly 放句尾，表示「老實說」。
Ha! Alice cries so much that she makes a pool of tears.
哈！愛麗絲哭到變成一池眼淚。

q: Later, Alice grows too big and gets stuck inside the White Rabbit's house. Have you ever felt your room was too small?
後來愛麗絲變得太大，卡在白兔的房子裡。你曾覺得你的房間太小嗎？
o: All the time. I need more storage.
一直都是。我需要更多收納空間。
storage = 收納空間。
Me too. My closet is always full.
我也是。我的衣櫃總是滿的。
No, my room is just right.
不會，我的房間剛剛好。
just right = 剛好。
Lucky you! Just right is hard to find in the city.
你真幸運！在城市裡剛剛好很難找。
Only when my friends visit.
只有朋友來的時候。
only when = 只有在…的時候。
True! Five people in a small room feels like Alice's problem.
真的！五個人擠在小房間就像愛麗絲的困境。

q: Her arm goes out the window and her foot goes up the chimney! If you could change one thing about your home, what would it be?
她的手伸出窗外，腳伸進煙囪！如果你能改變家裡一件事，會是什麼？
o: A bigger kitchen.
更大的廚房。
bigger = 更大的（比較級）。
Great choice. More room for cooking and baking!
好選擇。更多空間做菜和烘焙！
A balcony with plants.
有植物的陽台。
balcony = 陽台。
Lovely. A small garden in the city is a dream.
好可愛。城市裡的小花園是個夢想。
A bathtub. I only have a shower.
浴缸。我只有淋浴間。
bathtub = 浴缸；shower = 淋浴。
A hot bath after a long day is the best.
累了一整天後泡熱水澡最棒了。

q: In the end, Alice wakes up under a tree by the river. It was all a dream! Do you remember your dreams?
最後愛麗絲在河邊的樹下醒來。原來一切都是夢！你記得你的夢嗎？
o: Sometimes, but they fade fast.
有時候，但很快就忘了。
fade = 淡去、消失。
Same here. I try to write them down as soon as I wake up.
我也是。我會在醒來後馬上寫下來。
Yes, and they're often strange.
記得，而且常常很奇怪。
often = 常常。
Then you already live in a little Wonderland!
那你已經住在一個小仙境裡了！
Almost never.
幾乎從來不記得。
almost never = 幾乎從不。
Maybe you sleep very deeply. That's a good thing!
也許你睡得很沉。那是好事！

end: Thanks for falling down the rabbit hole with me!
謝謝你陪我一起掉進兔子洞！
